name: BRCA1/BRCA2-containing complex subunit 3

function.text: BRCC3 encodes lys-63-specific deubiquitinase BRCC36. Annotated molecular activities include metallopeptidase activity and K63-linked deubiquitinase activity. It participates in DNA repair-dependent chromatin remodeling and regulation of DNA repair.
